sketches.mechanism: Optional chaining returns nil and silently stops when any link in the chain is nil
sketches.resonance: Reaching for someone through a chain of connections, but if any one person is absent, the whole reach silently fails — you never arrive, and no one tells you why.

sketches.mechanism: An interface with no methods (marker interface) declares identity through pure emptiness
sketches.resonance: Sometimes what we are is not defined by what we can do, but by the name we carry — an empty body that still changes how the world treats us.
sketches.draft:
interface Grief extends java.io.Serializable {}
class Year implements Grief {}

sketches.mechanism: Metatables allow __index to redirect failed lookups to another table, so asking one thing a question silently asks another
sketches.resonance: When I don't have the answer, I become my mother — every question I can't field falls through to her, invisibly, without anyone noticing the substitution.
